items.question: How must the sacred ash be handled after completing the full oblation in the fire?
premises: The full oblation must first be performed in the ritual fire.
Ash is to be taken from that same fire after the oblation.
The taken ash must then be ritually dismissed.
items.inference: Therefore, upon completing the full oblation, the officiant should take ash from the fire and dismiss it according to ritual procedure.
uncertainties: The exact manner or location of dismissal implied by visarjayet is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having performed the full oblation, one should take the ash from that fire and then dismiss it.
